execution_policy: Only after the accepted A pair is supplied, the minimal literal binding is held and root authorizes its generated verification. Use existing isolated generated fixtures, never the real production guard or actual source. Retain first execution output and source identities. Root may apply repository-wide CI gates separately.
important_limitation: Both test fixtures reset PHASE_BINDINGS. Passing these methods does not authenticate the actual production literal; the separate source-only accepted-receipt comparison is mandatory.
